'''Thermax Ltd''' is an Indian multinational [[engineering]] conglomerate, involved in [[clean air]], [[clean energy]] and [[clean water]], headquartered in [[Pune]].<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Ghoshal |first1=Sumantra |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=DzRR9Q8MVoYC&dq=thermax+pune&pg=PA97 |title=Managing Radical Change: What Indian Companies Must Do to Become World-class |last2=Piramal |first2=Gita |last3=Bartlett |first3=Christopher A. |date=2002 |publisher=Penguin Books India |isbn=978-0-14-100022-0 |pages=97}}</ref>

== History ==
Thermax was founded by A. S. Bhathena in 1966 as Wanson India Ltd, manufacturing [[package boiler]]s. The company subsequently began manufacturing equipment related to [[cogeneration]], air pollution control, [[water treatment]] and [[absorption refrigeration]] among others.<ref>{{cite news |title=Thermax Limited |url=https://www.crisil.com/mnt/winshare/Ratings/RatingList/RatingDocs/ThermaxLimited_December%2020_%202024_RR_356311.html |access-date=8 May 2025 |work=CRISIL}}</ref><ref>{{cite news | url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/thermax-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-8165.cms | work=The Times of India | title=Thermax Ltd | access-date=18 February 2011 | archive-date=16 October 2012 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121016170613/http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/thermax-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-8165.cms | url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="test"/>

In 1981, Bhathena was succeeded by his son-in-law Rohinton Aga as chairman. In February 1995, the company went public and listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]]. After Aga's death in 1996, his wife [[Anu Aga]] took over the operations.<ref name="test">{{cite news |last1=Chaliawala |first1=Nehal |title=Thermax's big test: Can its energy transition bets revive investor confidence? |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/thermax-steam-renewable-energy-anu-aga-meher-pudumjee-shareholder-investors-revenue-margins-11745840686686.html |access-date=8 May 2025 |work=Mint |date=28 April 2025 |language=en}}</ref>

In 2009, it signed a 51–49 joint venture with [[US]] firm [[SPX Corporation]] to provide equipment and services for the Indian power sector.<ref>{{Cite news|date=2009-08-26|title=Thermax-SPX JV to have combined investment of 250 mln|work=Reuters|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/thermax-jv-investment-idINBMB00839720090826|access-date=2022-02-15|archive-date=15 February 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220215102451/https://www.reuters.com/article/thermax-jv-investment-idINBMB00839720090826|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="fb">{{Cite news|date=2009-08-26|title=Thermax in JV with U.S. firm SPX|work=Reuters|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/idINIndia-41984620090826|access-date=2022-02-15|archive-date=15 February 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220215102447/https://www.reuters.com/article/idINIndia-41984620090826|url-status=live}}</ref>

In 2010, it signed a joint venture agreement with [[US]]-based [[Babcock & Wilcox]] to manufacture super-critical boilers for the power sector.<ref>{{Cite news|date=2010-03-10|title=Thermax in JV with Babcock & Wilcox|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/thermax-in-jv-with-babcock-wilcox-110031000146_1.html|access-date=2022-02-15|archive-date=15 February 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220215102447/https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/thermax-in-jv-with-babcock-wilcox-110031000146_1.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

'''Thermax Ne0'''

In 2024, Thermax launched Thermax Ne0, a business focused on gas enrichment solutions. This growth unit was established to address growing demand for cleaner energy alternatives and supports industrial decarbonization through biogas purification and upgradation technologies. Thermax Ne0 offers Vacuum Pressure Swing Adsorption (VPSA) , Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA) and Membrane Separation technologies for biogas purification. Along with these, this unit also offers Green Hydrogen and Oxygen Purification solutions.<ref>{{Cite web |title= |url=https://www.thermaxglobal.com/industrial-products/air-pollution-control-systems/thermax-neo}}</ref>
